reason: The earlier audit was a point-in-time inference made before the detached controller copied its completed remote endpoint back to the worktree.
observed_timeline: The original detached launcher process was no longer visible to the local PID check while its child controller and remote SSH operations continued.
A second foreground invocation was attempted under the lock-only retry policy.
That second invocation hard-failed before remote launch because execution artifacts from the original invocation were already present.
The original controller subsequently completed the unique 25-round Flower endpoint, copied the remote result directory, and wrote fixed_endpoint_complete.json.
